instruction: The work is carried out with the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools. Update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save the finished model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. On this machine, Bonsai is installed as a Blender extension, so start `/opt/blender/blender` and use the Bonsai tools from that environment. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a compact apartment with Living, Kitchen, Bedroom, and Bath spaces around a simple partition layout. Preserve the existing shell, three partitions, four doors, two windows, and room geometry. Create one IfcGroup named Residential Unit R-11 and assign exactly those four spaces to it. Standardise all seven existing walls by assigning them to one shared IfcWallType named ApartmentWallType; no wall thickness, geometry, or material-layer change is required. Record the four rooms, seven walls, four doors, two windows, shared wall type, and residential unit group with revision code BONSAI-CLI-11.
